qe: During the Calcutta session of the Indian National Congress in December 1928, the younger nationalist elements expressed strong dissatisfaction with the adoption of Dominion Status. Which triad of leaders spearheaded this radical opposition?
qh: दिसंबर 1928 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के कलकत्ता अधिवेशन के दौरान, युवा राष्ट्रवादी तत्वों ने डोमिनियन स्टेटस (Dominion Status) को अपनाने पर कड़ा असंतोष व्यक्त किया। किस त्रिमूर्ति ने इस कट्टरपंथी विरोध का नेतृत्व किया था?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru, Subhash Chandra Bose, and Satyamurthy
C. Rajagopalachari, Vallabhbhai Patel, and Rajendra Prasad
Lala Lajpat Rai, Madan Mohan Malaviya, and N.C. Kelkar
Badruddin Tyabji, Pherozshah Mehta, and K.T. Telang
e: Detailed Explanation: At the December 1928 Calcutta session, the younger wing of the Congress led by Jawaharlal Nehru, Subhash Chandra Bose, and Satyamurthy fiercely opposed the compromise of Dominion Status, demanding instead the immediate adoption of Purna Swaraj (complete independence) as the party's ultimate goal.

qe: To accommodate the concerns of senior leaders like Mahatma Gandhi and Motilal Nehru who wished to avoid dropping the Dominion Status goal in haste, the Calcutta Congress of 1928 initially proposed what grace period for the British government to accept their terms?
qh: महात्मा गांधी और मोतीलाल नेहरू जैसे वरिष्ठ नेताओं की चिंताओं को दूर करने के लिए, जो जल्दबाजी में डोमिनियन स्टेटस के लक्ष्य को छोड़ना नहीं चाहते थे, 1928 के कलकत्ता कांग्रेस ने शुरू में ब्रिटिश सरकार को अपनी शर्तों को स्वीकार करने के लिए कितनी छूट अवधि (grace period) देने का प्रस्ताव किया था?
o: A two-year grace period
A one-year grace period
A six-month grace period
A five-year grace period
e: Detailed Explanation: Senior leaders argued that consensus on Dominion Status had been built with great difficulty. They initially suggested a two-year grace period for the British government to accept the Nehru Report's terms, which was later reduced to one year under pressure from the youth.

qe: Under pressure from younger radical cadres, the grace period given to the British government by the 1928 Calcutta Congress was reduced to one year. What conditional mass action was resolved if the terms were rejected by the end of 1929?
qh: युवा कट्टरपंथी कार्यकर्ताओं के दबाव में, 1928 के कलकत्ता कांग्रेस द्वारा ब्रिटिश सरकार को दी गई छूट अवधि को घटाकर एक वर्ष कर दिया गया था। यदि 1929 के अंत तक शर्तों को खारिज कर दिया जाता, तो किस सशर्त जन आंदोलन का संकल्प लिया गया था?
o: The Congress would demand complete independence and launch a civil disobedience movement
They would completely merge the Congress working committee with the Swarajist Party
The absolute legal transfer of the capital from Calcutta back to Murshidabad
Enforcing a mandatory progressive income tax surcharge on all urban local boards
e: Detailed Explanation: The compromise resolution dictated that if the British government did not accept a constitution based on Dominion Status by the end of 1929, the Congress would not only discard the demand but would also declare Purna Swaraj and launch a nationwide Civil Disobedience Movement.

qe: To spearhead an aggressive campaign against imported textiles in early 1929, the Congress Working Committee formally organized which specialized body?
qh: 1929 की शुरुआत में आयातित कपड़ों के खिलाफ एक आक्रामक अभियान का नेतृत्व करने के लिए, कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने औपचारिक रूप से किस विशेष निकाय का गठन किया था?
o: Foreign Cloth Boycott Committee
Satyagraha Sabha Executive Council
All India Harijan Sangh Board
Swadeshi Maritime Commerce Alliance
e: Detailed Explanation: In early 1929, the Congress Working Committee institutionalized the boycott movement by setting up the Foreign Cloth Boycott Committee to propagate aggressive boycott measures and organize public bonfires of foreign textiles.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi launched an intensive public bonfire campaign against foreign cloth in March 1929, which led to his immediate arrest. In which city was this campaign initiated?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने मार्च 1929 में विदेशी कपड़ों के खिलाफ एक गहन सार्वजनिक बोनफायर अभियान शुरू किया, जिसके कारण उन्हें तुरंत गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया। यह अभियान किस शहर में शुरू किया गया था?
o: Calcutta
Bombay
Ahmedabad
Madras
e: Detailed Explanation: Mahatma Gandhi initiated the aggressive foreign cloth boycott campaign in March 1929 from Calcutta. He was arrested by the colonial authorities for organizing public bonfires of imported cloth, which sparked retaliatory bonfires across India.

qe: The political temperature in India remained exceptionally high throughout 1929 due to a series of frontline events. Which of the following judicial cases was launched by the state in March 1929 to suppress socialist forces?
qh: 1929 के दौरान अग्रिम पंक्ति की घटनाओं की एक श्रृंखला के कारण भारत में राजनीतिक तापमान असाधारण रूप से उच्च बना रहा। समाजवादी ताकतों को दबाने के लिए मार्च 1929 में राज्य द्वारा निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा न्यायिक मामला शुरू किया गया था?
o: Meerut Conspiracy Case
Lahore Conspiracy Case
Kakori Conspiracy Trial
Muzaffarpur Bomb Case
e: Detailed Explanation: In March 1929, the colonial state launched the famous Meerut Conspiracy Case, arresting prominent labor leaders and communists to suppress the growth of trade unionism and socialist ideas.

qe: A major political shift occurred in Great Britain in May 1929 when a minority Labour government came to power. Who was the newly elected British Prime Minister who chose Wedgewood Benn as the Secretary of State for India?
qh: मई 1929 में ग्रेट ब्रिटेन में एक बड़ा राजनीतिक बदलाव आया जब अल्पसंख्यक लेबर सरकार सत्ता में आई। नवनिर्वाचित ब्रिटिश प्रधानमंत्री कौन थे जिन्होंने वेजवुड बेन (Wedgewood Benn) को भारत के राज्य सचिव के रूप में चुना था?
o: Ramsay MacDonald
Stanley Baldwin
Winston Churchill
Edwin Montagu
e: Detailed Explanation: In May 1929, the Conservative government in Britain was replaced by a minority Labour government led by Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald. Under his administration, Wedgewood Benn was appointed as the Secretary of State for India.

qe: On October 31, 1929, Viceroy Lord Irwin issued a historic official declaration in the Indian Gazette before the Simon report was published. What was the explicit text purpose of this declaration?
qh: 31 अक्टूबर, 1929 को वायसराय लॉर्ड इरविन ने साइमन रिपोर्ट प्रकाशित होने से पहले इंडियन गजट में एक ऐतिहासिक आधिकारिक घोषणा जारी की। इस घोषणा का स्पष्ट पाठ्य उद्देश्य (text purpose) क्या था?
o: To state clearly that the attainment of Dominion Status was implicit in the Declaration of 1917
To announce the immediate and absolute legal abolition of the system of Dyarchy in provinces
To implement universal adult franchise for all male and female voters across British India
To legally transfer the complete control of the higher judiciary directly to the local Assemblies
e: Detailed Explanation: Lord Irwin's declaration on October 31, 1929, aimed to restore faith in British policy. He officially stated that it was implicit in the declaration of 1917 that the natural issue of India's constitutional progress was the attainment of Dominion Status, though he purposefully avoided outlining any time scale.

qe: Following Lord Irwin's declaration, prominent Indian national leaders convened a conference and issued the 'Delhi Manifesto' on November 2, 1929. What primary condition did they lay down for attending the proposed Round Table Conference?
qh: लॉर्ड इरविन की घोषणा के बाद, प्रमुख भारतीय राष्ट्रीय नेताओं ने एक सम्मेलन बुलाया और 2 नवंबर, 1929 को 'दिल्ली घोषणापत्र' (Delhi Manifesto) जारी किया। उन्होंने प्रस्तावित गोलमेज सम्मेलन में भाग लेने के लिए कौन सी प्राथमिक शर्त रखी थी?
o: The purpose of the conference should be to formulate a constitution for implementation of Dominion Status, acting as a constituent assembly
The immediate and complete absolute dissolution of the central Imperial Legislative Council
The mandatory selection of all conference delegates via competitive testing metrics in English
The strict exclusion of any non-official members who belonged to the elite landlord classes
e: Detailed Explanation: The Delhi Manifesto specified that the Round Table Conference should not waste time debating *whether* or *when* India would reach Dominion Status. Instead, its sole operational purpose should be to act as a constituent assembly to draft a constitution implementing immediate Dominion Status.

qe: Apart from defining the core purpose of the Round Table Conference, what structural demands were put forward by the nationalist leaders within the 1929 Delhi Manifesto?
qh: गोलमेज सम्मेलन के मुख्य उद्देश्य को परिभाषित करने के अलावा, 1929 के दिल्ली घोषणापत्र के भीतर राष्ट्रवादी नेताओं द्वारा कौन सी संरचनात्मक मांगें रखी गई थीं?
o: The Congress should have majority representation at the conference, and there should be a general amnesty for political prisoners
The complete legal transfer of the portfolio finance directly to popular provincial ministries
The total structural replacement of the bicameral Central legislature with a unicameral board
A complete legislative termination of the separate electorates system across all provinces
e: Detailed Explanation: The Delhi Manifesto laid down three clear conditions: the conference must focus strictly on implementing Dominion Status, the Indian National Congress must hold a majority representation at the table, and the government must provide a general amnesty for political prisoners.

qe: In December 1929, Gandhi and Motilal Nehru met Lord Irwin to seek a definitive assurance regarding the true purpose of the Round Table Conference. What was the Viceroy's response, setting the stage for direct confrontation?
qh: दिसंबर 1929 में, गांधी और मोतीलाल नेहरू ने गोलमेज सम्मेलन के वास्तविक उद्देश्य के संबंध में एक निश्चित आश्वासन प्राप्त करने के लिए लॉर्ड इरविन से मुलाकात की। वायसराय की क्या प्रतिक्रिया थी, जिसने सीधे टकराव की स्थिति पैदा कर दी?
o: He rejected the demands put forward in the Delhi Manifesto and refused to provide an assurance that the conference was to draft a scheme for immediate Dominion Status
He completely accepted the terms and declared the immediate establishment of a sovereign constituent assembly
He signed a formal legal pact transferring the absolute command of the armed forces to the Congress
He ordered the immediate arrest of the entire Congress Working Committee inside the Viceroy's executive chamber
e: Detailed Explanation: During the December 1929 meeting, Lord Irwin explicitly refused to provide any assurance that the purpose of the upcoming Round Table Conference was to draft a scheme for immediate Dominion Status. By rejecting the Delhi Manifesto's terms, he closed the doors to negotiation, making confrontation inevitable.

qe: Jawaharlal Nehru was nominated as the President for the historic Lahore session of the Congress in December 1929 despite opposition from 15 out of 18 Provincial Congress Committees. Who backed his nomination, and what was a primary reason for his choice?
qh: दिसंबर 1929 में कांग्रेस के ऐतिहासिक लाहौर सत्र के लिए जवाहरलाल नेहरू को 18 में से 15 प्रांतीय कांग्रेस समितियों के विरोध के बावजूद अध्यक्ष के रूप में नामित किया गया था। उनके नामांकन का किसने समर्थन किया था, और उनके चयन का प्राथमिक कारण क्या था?
o: He was backed by Mahatma Gandhi to acknowledge the upsurge of youth who made the anti-Simon campaign a massive success
He was supported by the wealthy aristocratic landlords of the Landholders' Society to protect their agrarian estates
He was backed by the orthodox ulema of the Deoband school to counter Sir Syed Ahmed Khan's organizations
He was chosen via an open universal adult franchise tracking system managed by local municipal boards
e: Detailed Explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru's nomination was heavily pushed and backed by Mahatma Gandhi. He was chosen because he had popularized the concept of Purna Swaraj and to officially acknowledge the powerful upsurge of the younger generation who had driven the anti-Simon agitations.

qe: In his iconic presidential address at the December 1929 Lahore session, how did Jawaharlal Nehru define his personal ideological convictions before the delegates?
qh: दिसंबर 1929 के ऐतिहासिक लाहौर सत्र में अपने अध्यक्षीय भाषण में, जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने प्रतिनिधियों के सामने अपनी व्यक्तिगत वैचारिक मान्यताओं को कैसे परिभाषित किया था?
o: He frankly confessed that he was a socialist and a republican, and no believer in kings, princes, or the modern kings of industry
He declared his absolute structural adherence to the traditional fatalistic principles of niyati
He stated that he was a strict conservative defender of the caste-segregated chaturvarna system by birth
He defined himself as a pro-British merchant capitalist who supported foreign managing agencies
e: Detailed Explanation: In a radical departure from older moderate traditions, Nehru proudly declared from his presidential chair: 'I must frankly confess that I am a socialist and a republican, and am no believer in kings and princes, or in the order which produces the modern kings of industry...'

qe: Which of the following constitutional decisions was NOT taken during the historic December 1929 Lahore session of the Indian National Congress?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संवैधानिक निर्णय भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के ऐतिहासिक दिसंबर 1929 के लाहौर सत्र के दौरान नहीं लिया गया था?
o: To accept the invitation to participate fully in the upcoming London Round Table Conference
Complete independence was formally declared as the ultimate aim of the Congress
The Congress Working Committee was authorized to launch a program of civil disobedience including non-payment of taxes
All members of the colonial legislatures were asked to immediately resign their seats
e: Detailed Explanation: The Lahore session took highly radical steps: it officially resolved to completely boycott the Round Table Conference, declared Purna Swaraj (complete independence) as its sole objective, authorized a civil disobedience and tax revolt campaign, and ordered all legislators to resign.

qe: What specific date was officially fixed by the December 1929 Lahore Congress session to be celebrated everywhere across villages and towns as the first Independence (Swarajya) Day?
qh: दिसंबर 1929 के लाहौर कांग्रेस सत्र द्वारा किस विशिष्ट तिथि को पूरे गांवों और शहरों में पहले स्वतंत्रता (स्वराज्य) दिवस के रूप में मनाने के लिए आधिकारिक तौर पर तय किया गया था?
o: January 26, 1930
December 31, 1929
January 31, 1930
March 12, 1930
e: Detailed Explanation: The Lahore Congress passed a resolution fixing January 26, 1930, as the first historic Independence Day (Swarajya Day), mandating the hoisting of the national flag and reading of the independence pledge nationwide.

qe: At midnight on December 31, 1929, Jawaharlal Nehru hoisted the newly adopted tricolor flag of freedom amidst slogans of Inquilab Zindabad. On the banks of which river did this historic event take place?
qh: 31 दिसंबर, 1929 की आधी रात को, जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने इंकलाब जिंदाबाद के नारों के बीच स्वतंत्रता के नए अपनाए गए तिरंगे झंडे को फहराया था। यह ऐतिहासिक घटना किस नदी के तट पर हुई थी?
o: River Ravi
River Ganga
River Yamuna
River Indus
e: Detailed Explanation: At the stroke of midnight on December 31, 1929, marking the expiration of the one-year grace period given to the British government, Jawaharlal Nehru unfurled the flag of complete independence on the banks of the River Ravi in Lahore.

qe: The 'Independence Pledge' read out all over the country on January 26, 1930, is supposed to have been drafted by Mahatma Gandhi. What moral and theological assertion did it make regarding British rule?
qh: 26 जनवरी, 1930 को देश भर में पढ़ा गया 'स्वतंत्रता का संकल्प' (Independence Pledge) महात्मा Gandhi द्वारा तैयार किया गया माना जाता है। इसने ब्रिटिश शासन के संबंध में कौन सा नैतिक और धार्मिक दावा किया था?
o: We hold it a crime against man and God to submit any longer to British rule
We pledge absolute spiritual compliance with the providential mission of the British Crown
We declare that the traditional shastras mandate a complete submission to foreign administrations
We hold it a sacred duty to support the structural retention of British managing agencies permanently
e: Detailed Explanation: The Independence Pledge took a uncompromising ethical stand against colonialism, explicitly stating: 'We hold it a crime against man and God to submit any longer to British rule,' and called for complete non-cooperation and tax resistance to end it.

qe: According to the economic critique outlined within the 1930 Independence Pledge, how were the village and traditional industries of India being systematically ruined by the British Raj?
qh: 1930 के स्वतंत्रता संकल्प (Independence Pledge) के भीतर रेखांकित आर्थिक आलोचना के अनुसार, ब्रिटिश राज द्वारा भारत के ग्रामीण और पारंपरिक उद्योगों को व्यवस्थित रूप से कैसे बर्बाद किया जा रहा था?
o: By high revenue demands with no substitutions made, while customs, currency, and exchange rates were manipulated to India's disadvantage
By forcing all artisans to completely migrate to the alpine tundra zones to establish factories
By providing free high-quality industrial machinery exclusively to lower-caste untouchable weavers
By legally striking down the transferability and free sale of all real estate land assets in towns
e: Detailed Explanation: The pledge detailed the economic destruction under British rule, emphasizing that high land revenues heavily burdened the peasantry, village crafts were destroyed without alternatives, and the state manipulated customs tariffs, currency valuation, and exchange rates to benefit British manufacturers.

qe: To carry forward the mandate of the Lahore Congress, Mahatma Gandhi presented a charter of 'Eleven Demands' to the government. What ultimatum deadline was given to the Viceroy to accept or reject these demands?
qh: लाहौर कांग्रेस के जनादेश को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए, महात्मा गांधी ने सरकार के सामने 'ग्यारह मांगों' (Eleven Demands) का एक चार्टर प्रस्तुत किया। इन मांगों को स्वीकार या अस्वीकार करने के लिए वायसराय को अल्टीमेटम की कौन सी समयसीमा दी गई थी?
o: January 31, 1930
January 26, 1930
March 12, 1930
April 6, 1930
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi formulated eleven demands covering diverse class interests and submitted them to Viceroy Lord Irwin, giving a strict ultimatum deadline of January 31, 1930, to accept them or face a mass movement.

qe: Within the charter of Eleven Demands, what structural fiscal reform did Mahatma Gandhi demand regarding the administrative and military expenditure of the colonial government?
qh: ग्यारह मांगों के चार्टर के भीतर, महात्मा गांधी ने औपनिवेशिक सरकार के प्रशासनिक और सैन्य व्यय के संबंध में किस संरचनात्मक वित्तीय सुधार की मांग की थी?
o: Reduce expenditure on the Army and civil services by 50 per cent
Increase the military expenditure budget by exactly half to secure coastal borders
Transfer the absolute funding of the civil services directly to the British treasury in London
Abolish all financial allocations assigned to the Criminal Investigation Department entirely
e: Detailed Explanation: Under the issues of general interest within his eleven demands, Gandhi targeted the expensive colonial apparatus, demanding that expenditure on the British Indian Army and the civil services be slashed by 50 per cent.

qe: Which specific judicial and administrative reform did Mahatma Gandhi demand regarding the state's intelligence apparatus within his 1930 Eleven Demands charter?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने अपने 1930 के ग्यारह मांगों के चार्टर के भीतर राज्य के खुफिया तंत्र (intelligence apparatus) के संबंध में किस विशिष्ट न्यायिक और प्रशासनिक सुधार की मांग की थी?
o: Carry out reforms in the Criminal Investigation Department (CID)
The complete administrative dissolution of all provincial Zila courts
Subordinating the intelligence services directly to the executive command of the Swarajists
Enforcing a total ban on hiring Indian origin secret tracking spies inside the bureau
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi's charter explicitly demanded comprehensive reforms in the functioning of the colonial state's intelligence network, specifically targeting the high-handedness of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).

qe: Regarding the civil liberties of citizens and self-defense, what legislative change did Mahatma Gandhi demand concerning firearms licenses within his Eleven Demands?
qh: नागरिकों की नागरिक स्वतंत्रता और आत्मरक्षा के संबंध में, महात्मा गांधी ने अपनी ग्यारह मांगों के भीतर आग्नेयास्त्र लाइसेंस (firearms licenses) के संबंध में किस विधायी बदलाव की मांग की थी?
o: Change the Arms Act allowing popular control of the issue of firearms licenses
The absolute and immediate global disarmament of all native populations permanently
Restricting the ownership of firearms licenses exclusively to the wealthy aristocratic zamindars
Mandating that firearms licenses must be cleared by a special three-judge panel of the High Court
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi demanded a democratic modification of the restrictive colonial security laws, calling for an amendment to the Arms Act to allow popular, representative control over the issuance of firearms licenses to citizens.

qe: What specific currency and macroeconomic adjustment did Mahatma Gandhi include under the 'Specific Bourgeois Demands' section of his eleven demands to protect Indian business interests?
qh: भारतीय व्यावसायिक हितों की रक्षा के लिए महात्मा गांधी ने अपनी ग्यारह मांगों के 'विशिष्ट बुर्जुआ मांग' (Specific Bourgeois Demands) खंड के तहत कौन सा विशिष्ट मुद्रा और व्यापक आर्थिक समायोजन शामिल किया था?
o: Reduce the rupee-sterling exchange ratio to 1s 4d
Increase the rupee-sterling exchange ratio to a fixed baseline threshold of 2s
The absolute legal adoption of gold bullion as the sole medium of market transaction
Scrapping any requirement for currency exchange tracking metrics with Great Britain
e: Detailed Explanation: To safeguard the interests of the indigenous business class and commercial captains, Gandhi demanded a macroeconomic adjustment, specifically requesting that the overvalued rupee-sterling exchange ratio be reduced to 1s 4d.

qe: Apart from the exchange ratio, which two critical commercial demands were raised by Mahatma Gandhi to shield native Indian industries from unfair foreign maritime and textile competition?
qh: विनिमय अनुपात के अलावा, विदेशी समुद्री और कपड़ा प्रतिस्पर्धा से घरेलू भारतीय उद्योगों की रक्षा के लिए महात्मा गांधी द्वारा कौन सी दो महत्वपूर्ण व्यावसायिक मांगें उठाई गई थीं?
o: Introduce textile protection and reserve coastal shipping for Indians
The total privatization of all tax-free lands and free sale of coastal ports
Levying a flat 100% duty on all native khadi hand-spinning workshops
The mandatory closing of all newly established national colleges in Calcutta
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi's bourgeois demands directly targeted British trade dominance by demanding the introduction of protective tariffs for the native textile industry and reserving lucrative coastal shipping routes exclusively for Indian merchant vessels.

qe: Under the 'Specific Peasant Demands' section of his eleven demands, what massive fiscal relief did Mahatma Gandhi demand regarding land tax assessments?
qh: अपनी ग्यारह मांगों के 'विशिष्ट किसान मांग' (Specific Peasant Demands) खंड के तहत, महात्मा गांधी ने भूमि कर आकलन के संबंध में किस बड़े वित्तीय राहत की मांग की थी?
o: Reduce land revenue by 50 per cent
The complete absolute abolition of all land revenue collection forever
Transfer the collection of land revenue directly to the local village moneylenders
Imposing a uniform flat-rate tax surcharge on all tax-free lands in Bengal
e: Detailed Explanation: To alleviate the crushing poverty of the agrarian sector, Gandhi put forward a prominent peasant demand, calling upon the British Raj to reduce land revenue assessments by 50 per cent.

qe: Which highly symbolic fiscal demand did Mahatma Gandhi highlight as a specific peasant grievance, calling for its universal abolition alongside the state's commercial monopoly?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने एक विशिष्ट किसान शिकायत के रूप में किस अत्यधिक प्रतीकात्मक वित्तीय मांग पर प्रकाश डाला, और राज्य के व्यावसायिक एकाधिकार के साथ-साथ इसे पूरी तरह से समाप्त करने का आह्वान किया?
o: Abolish the salt tax and government's salt monopoly
The complete structural cancellation of the Union board taxes in Midnapore
Abolition of the progressive income tax imposed on wealthy urban middle classes
Scrapping any excise duties levied on consumer goods consumed by the rich
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi identified the salt tax as deeply oppressive. Under his peasant demands, he called for the complete abolition of the salt tax and the state's manufacturing monopoly over salt, which set the formula for the future movement.

qe: With no positive response forthcoming from Viceroy Irwin on the eleven demands, the Congress Working Committee invested Mahatma Gandhi with full powers to launch the Civil Disobedience Movement. By late February 1930, why did Gandhi choose salt as the central formula for the mass struggle?
qh: ग्यारह मांगों पर वायसराय इरविन की ओर से कोई सकारात्मक प्रतिक्रिया न मिलने पर, कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने महात्मा गांधी को सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन शुरू करने के पूर्ण अधिकार सौंप दिए। फरवरी 1930 के अंत तक, गांधी ने जन संघर्ष के मुख्य सूत्र के रूप में नमक को क्यों चुना?
o: Salt was a universal grievance that linked the ideal of Swaraj directly with the starving millions without any socially divisive implications
The colonial judiciary had passed a secret decree legally banning the ingestion of sea water products
Salt manufacturing yielded infinite gold reserves that completely funded the Congress volunteer corps
The British Cabinet had offered massive financial subsidies exclusively to native salt manufacturers
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi recognized salt as a master stroke for mobilization. It was an item of daily consumption for every human being, meaning a tax on it hit the starving millions, the poor, and the sick alike. Choosing salt linked the abstract ideal of Swaraj with a universal grievance of the rural poor without raising socially divisive issues like a anti-rent campaign against landlords.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi famously branded the salt tax in 'Young India' as a highly regressive fiscal measure using which explicit description?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने 'यंग इंडिया' में नमक कर को एक अत्यधिक प्रतिगामी वित्तीय उपाय के रूप में किस स्पष्ट विवरण का उपयोग करते हुए प्रसिद्ध रूप से ब्रांडेड किया था?
o: It is the most inhuman poll tax the ingenuity of man can devise
It represents a sunless dawn unworthy of England to offer and India to accept
It functions very much like a sponge drawing up all good things from the Ganges
It is a highly progressive macroeconomic stabilization tool designed to curb inflation
e: Detailed Explanation: Condemning the state monopoly, Gandhi stated: 'There is no other article like salt, outside water, by taxing which the government can reach the starving millions... it is the most inhuman poll tax the ingenuity of man can devise.'

qe: On March 12, 1930, Mahatma Gandhi formally launched the Civil Disobedience Movement by initiating the historic Dandi March. How many selected members of the Sabarmati Ashram accompanied him at the start of this march?
qh: 12 मार्च, 1930 को महात्मा गांधी ने ऐतिहासिक दांडी यात्रा शुरू करके सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन का औपचारिक शुभारंभ किया। इस यात्रा की शुरुआत में साबरमती आश्रम के कितने चयनित सदस्य उनके साथ थे?
o: Seventy-eight members
Seventy-two delegates
One hundred and forty-five volunteers
Exactly sixty activists
e: Detailed Explanation: The Dandi March began on March 12, 1930, from Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad. Gandhi set out on foot along with a tightly disciplined band of exactly seventy-eight selected members of the ashram.

qe: What was the exact physical distance mapped out for the historic Dandi March journey from Sabarmati Ashram through the villages of Gujarat to the coast?
qh: साबरमती आश्रम से गुजरात के गांवों के रास्ते तट तक ऐतिहासिक दांडी यात्रा की कुल दूरी कितनी तय की गई थी?
o: 240 miles
100 miles
350 miles
150 miles
e: Detailed Explanation: The itinerary of the Dandi March traversed through the heart of rural Gujarat. The total straight physical distance mapped out for the march from Ahmedabad to the coastal village of Dandi was 240 miles.

qe: Before setting out on the Dandi March, Mahatma Gandhi issued specific action directives to the public. Which of the following instructions was included in his directions?
qh: दांडी यात्रा पर निकलने से पहले, महात्मा गांधी ने जनता को विशिष्ट कार्रवाई निर्देश जारी किए। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा निर्देश उनके निर्देशों में शामिल था?
o: Civil disobedience of the salt law should be started wherever possible, foreign liquor and cloth shops picketed, and government servants can resign
To launch an immediate armed parameters conflict to seize the weapons stored inside the local arsenals
The complete operational closure of all native national schools and Khadi weaving workshops
Filing thousands of joint property lawsuits before the special three-judge panel of the High Court
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi's directions provided a comprehensive blueprint for mass action: violating salt laws wherever possible, picketing foreign cloth/liquor stores, withholding taxes if capable, lawyers giving up practice, and government servants resigning from their posts, all under a strict clause of non-violence.

qe: On which historic date did Mahatma Gandhi reach the coast at Dandi and pick up a lump of natural salt, formally violating the colonial salt law and launching a wave of defiance across India?
qh: किस ऐतिहासिक तारीख को महात्मा गांधी दांडी तट पर पहुंचे और प्राकृतिक नमक का एक ढेला उठाया, जिससे औपनिवेशिक नमक कानून का औपचारिक उल्लंघन हुआ और पूरे भारत में अवज्ञा की लहर शुरू हो गई?
o: April 6, 1930
March 12, 1930
January 26, 1930
e: Detailed Explanation: After marching on foot for 24 days, Gandhi reached the sea coast at Dandi on April 5. On the morning of April 6, 1930, he picked up a lump of natural salt from the beach, symbolically breaking the law and signaling the country to manufacture salt.

qe: Reflecting the immense mass support for Gandhi's appeal during the Dandi March, how many traditional village officials resigned from their government posts in Gujarat?
qh: दांडी यात्रा के दौरान गांधी की अपील के प्रति भारी जनसमर्थन को दर्शाते हुए, गुजरात में कितने पारंपरिक ग्रामीण अधिकारियों ने अपने सरकारी पदों से इस्तीफा दे दिया था?
o: 300 village officials
72 village officials
1,000 village officials
Strictly 50 officials
e: Detailed Explanation: The Dandi March had a profound structural impact on the colonial administrative apparatus. In response to Gandhi's direct moral appeal for non-cooperation, exactly 300 traditional village officials resigned from their administrative posts in Gujarat.

qe: Whose high-profile arrest in April 1930 for defiance of the salt law evoked massive hostile demonstrations and strikes across major presidency cities like Madras, Calcutta, and Karachi?
qh: नमक कानून की अवज्ञा करने के लिए अप्रैल 1930 में किसकी हाई-प्रोफाइल गिरफ्तारी ने मद्रास, कलकत्ता और कराची जैसे प्रमुख प्रेसीडेंसी शहरों में बड़े पैमाने पर उग्र प्रदर्शनों और हड़तालों को जन्म दिया था?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
Subhash Chandra Bose
Dr. Rajendra Prasad
e: Detailed Explanation: Following Gandhi's action, top national leaders began manufactured salt across provinces. When Jawaharlal Nehru was arrested in April 1930 for violating the salt law, it triggered massive urban protests and general strikes in cities like Madras, Calcutta, and Karachi.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi was abruptly arrested on May 4, 1930, after he formally announced his intention to lead a non-violent raid on which specific government installations on the west coast?
qh: महात्मा गांधी को 4 मई, 1930 को अचानक गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया, जब उन्होंने पश्चिमी तट पर किस विशिष्ट सरकारी प्रतिष्ठान पर अहिंसक छापे का नेतृत्व करने के अपने इरादे की औपचारिक घोषणा की थी?
o: Dharasana Salt Works
Chittagong Arsenal Depot
Colaba Marine Works Observatory
Tuticorin Shipping Harbour Yards
e: Detailed Explanation: To intensify the movement, Gandhi sent an advance notice to the Viceroy declaring his plan to lead a peaceful raid on the government-owned Dharasana Salt Works on the western coast of Gujarat. The government struck back by arresting him on the night of May 4, 1930.

qe: Following Mahatma Gandhi's arrest in May 1930, the Congress Working Committee expanded its operational directives. Which specific campaign did they sanction for the traditional Zamindari revenue areas?
qh: मई 1930 में महात्मा गांधी की गिरफ्तारी के बाद, कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने अपने परिचालन निर्देशों का विस्तार किया। उन्होंने पारंपरिक जमींदारी राजस्व क्षेत्रों के लिए किस विशिष्ट अभियान को मंजूरी दी थी?
o: A no-chowkidara-tax campaign
Non-payment of land revenue in ryotwari areas
The complete structural violation of forest laws
The immediate armed takeover of all local salt factories
e: Detailed Explanation: After Gandhi's internment, the CWC diversified the civil disobedience program according to regional land revenue structures. For the landholder-dominated Zamindari areas (such as Bihar and Bengal), they formally sanctioned a highly effective 'no-chowkidara-tax campaign'.

qe: What localized campaign of defiance did the Congress Working Committee specifically sanction for the Central Provinces following the implementation of strict post-arrest guidelines in May 1930?
qh: मई 1930 में गिरफ्तारी के बाद सख्त दिशानिर्देशों के लागू होने के बाद कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने मध्य प्रांत (Central Provinces) के लिए विशेष रूप से किस स्थानीय अवज्ञा अभियान को मंजूरी दी थी?
o: The systematic structural violation of forest laws
A comprehensive no-chowkidara-tax campaign
Non-payment of land revenue in ryotwari fields
The absolute boycott of all vernacular media publication channels
e: Detailed Explanation: Adapting the resistance to local geographic and legal parameters, the Congress Working Committee directed the cadres in the heavily forested Central Provinces to launch a campaign centered on the systematic structural violation of restrictive colonial forest laws.

qe: A survey routing pathway maps a precise right-angled triangular matrix layout from base O. A transport car travels 48 km North, and then changes orientation to drive 14 km East to reach checkpoint D. Calculate the direct straight-line distance from O to D.
qh: एक अनुसंधान वाहन बेस O से 48 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलता है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 14 किमी जाकर चेकपॉइंट D पर पहुँचता है। O से D की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 50 km
62 km
54 km
52 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial movement tracks a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs of 48 km and 14 km. The hypotenuse represents the direct straight-line distance.
Applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{48^2 + 14^2} = \sqrt{2304 + 196} = \sqrt{2500} = \mathbf{50\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological survey tracking ecosystem energy metrics across an alluvial marsh plain, if the measured Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) is 58,000 units and the energy accumulated as Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 38,000 units, calculate the energy spent during plant metabolic respiration (R).
qh: एक मैदानी क्षेत्र में ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि मापी गई सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 58,000 इकाइयाँ है और शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) के रूप में संचित ऊर्जा 38,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
96,000 units
40,000 units
18,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the core ecological relationship formula: $NPP = GPP - R$, we isolate respiration losses: $R = GPP - NPP$.
Substituting the given variables: $R = 58,000 - 38,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: During the intense agitations of 1930, the city of Sholapur witnessed a highly explosive public upsurge in response to Mahatma Gandhi's arrest. What was a unique feature of the Sholapur resistance?
qh: 1930 के तीव्र आंदोलनों के दौरान, सोलापुर शहर में महात्मा गांधी की गिरफ्तारी के जवाब में एक अत्यधिक विस्फोटक जन उभार देखा गया। सोलापुर प्रतिरोध की एक अनूठी विशेषता क्या थी?
o: The industrial textile workers went on a rampage, effectively capturing control of the city administration for days until martial law was imposed
The local population completely migrated away to join the no-tax campaign in Midnapore plains
The local Munsiff courts successfully functioned without requiring any official executive seals
The complete peaceful submission of the entire volunteer corps to the District Magistrate directly
e: Detailed Explanation: Sholapur in Maharashtra recorded the fiercest urban response to Gandhi's arrest. The powerful industrial textile mill workers went on strike, clashed violently with the police, burned government buildings, and successfully established parallel control over the city administration for several days until the military stepped in and imposed strict martial law.

qe: The 'Hindustan Republican Association/Army' (HRA), a prominent revolutionary organization that launched armed operations in Northern India in October 1924, was founded by which triad of leaders?
qh: अक्टूबर 1924 में उत्तरी भारत में सशस्त्र अभियानों की शुरुआत करने वाले एक प्रमुख क्रांतिकारी संगठन 'हिंदुस्तान रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन/आर्मी' (HRA) की स्थापना किस त्रिमूर्ति द्वारा की गई थी?
o: Ramprasad Bismil, Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee, and Sachin Sanyal
Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Chandra Shekhar Azad
Surya Sen, Anant Singh, and Ganesh Ghosh
Jawaharlal Nehru, Subhash Chandra Bose, and Satyamurthy
e: Detailed Explanation: The Hindustan Republican Association (HRA) was established in October 1924 at a convention in Kanpur by pioneering revolutionary nationalist leaders Ramprasad Bismil, Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee, and Sachin Sanyal, aiming to overthrow the Raj via an armed revolution.

qe: The Government of India Act, 1919 consolidated communal and class electorates across British India. Which of the following statements represents a major structural drawback of this mechanism as highlighted by early nationalist analysts?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1919 ने ब्रिटिश भारत में सांप्रदायिक और वर्गीय निर्वाचन मंडलों को और मजबूत किया। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन इस तंत्र की एक बड़ी संरचनात्मक कमी का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जैसा कि शुरुआती राष्ट्रवादी विश्लेषकों द्वारा रेखांकित किया गया था?
o: It deepened communal divisions, effectively checking the natural process of social and national unity
It completely eliminated the legislative majority of official bureaucratic nominees inside the councils
It successfully transferred 100% of portfolio finance directly to popular native ministries
It forced the absolute legal separation of the judicial high court benches from executive oversight
e: Detailed Explanation: By reinforcing and extending separate communal and class electorates to non-Muslim minority communities (like the Sikhs and Europeans), the 1919 Act deliberately institutionalized social divisions, checking the growth of an integrated national consciousness and complicating the freedom struggle.

qe: Under the system of Dyarchy introduced by the 1919 Act, which specific administrative subject was kept under the 'Reserved' list, managed directly by the Governor and his bureaucratic executive council?
qh: 1919 के अधिनियम द्वारा शुरू की गई द्वैध शासन व्यवस्था के तहत, कौन सा विशिष्ट प्रशासनिक विषय 'आरक्षित' (Reserved) सूची के तहत रखा गया था, जिसका प्रबंधन सीधे राज्यपाल और उनकी नौकरशाही कार्यकारी परिषद द्वारा किया जाता था?
o: Law and order, finance, land revenue, and irrigation
Education, public health, local self-government, and agriculture
Vernacular media registration, library management, and primary education text compilation
The corporate financing of swadeshi textile mills and rural matching enterprises
e: Detailed Explanation: Dyarchy split provincial subjects into two lists. Critical portfolios like law and order, public finance, land revenue, justice, and irrigation were kept under the 'Reserved' list, managed directly by the Governor and his council of bureaucrats without accountability to the legislature.

qe: The 'Act for Better Government of India, 1858' introduced a profound constitutional shift in the administrative structure of the sub-continent by executing which measure?
qh: ऐतिहासिक 'Act for Better Government of India, 1858' ने कौन सा उपाय करके उपमहाद्वीप के प्रशासनिक ढांचे में एक गहरा संवैधानिक बदलाव पेश किया था?
o: Transferring the power to govern from the East India Company directly to the British Crown, to be wielded through a Secretary of State
Establishing complete provincial autonomy under popular native ministerial portfolios with zero central control
Abolishing the office of the Viceroy and creating the separate Federal Court structure at Allahabad
Scrapping the supervisory control of the British Parliament over Indian revenues permanently
e: Detailed Explanation: Following the 1857 Revolt, the Act of 1858 dissolved the East India Company. It transferred the sovereign power to govern India directly to the British Crown, to be exercised through a cabinet post, the Secretary of State for India, who was assisted by a 15-member council and made directly answerable to the British Parliament.

qe: The judicial framework of the Cornwallis Code of 1793 established a major milestone in modern Indian administrative history by firmly introducing which concept?
qh: 1793 के कॉर्नवॉलिस कोड के न्यायिक ढांचे ने किस अवधारणा को दृढ़ता से पेश करके आधुनिक भारतीय प्रशासनिक इतिहास में एक बुनियादी मील का पत्थर स्थापित किया?
o: The principle of the sovereignty of law and the separation of revenue and justice administration
The absolute legal immunity of all colonial government officials from civil court oversight
The mandatory use of English instead of vernacular languages across all local lower subdivisions
The total structural centralization of all judicial functions under the district Collector
e: Detailed Explanation: The Cornwallis Code of 1793 was a landmark because it established the sovereignty of law and the separation of powers. It separated revenue administration from justice, divested the Collector of judicial duties, and made government officials answerable to civil courts for official actions.

qe: The 'Treaty of Sevres', signed in May 1920 between the Allied powers and Turkey, had what direct impact on the global status of the Ottoman caliphate, deeply incensing Indian Muslims?
qh: मई 1920 में मित्र देशों की शक्तियों और तुर्की के बीच हस्ताक्षरित 'सेवर्स की संधि' (Treaty of Sevres) का ओटोमन खलीफा की वैश्विक स्थिति पर क्या सीधा प्रभाव पड़ा, जिसने भारतीय मुसलमानों को गहरा नाराज कर दिया?
o: It completely dismembered the Ottoman Empire and finalized the removal of the Khalifa from power
It successfully extended the legal control of the Khalifa over all Muslim sacred places globally
It granted absolute sovereign independence to Turkey and its neighboring Arab territories unconditionally
It forced the British Treasury to pay all administrative salaries of the Secretary of State from London funds
e: Detailed Explanation: The Treaty of Sevres completely partitioned and dismembered the Ottoman Empire, stripping the Sultan of Turkey of his territories and removing him from power. This directly targeted the religious status of the Khalifa, which incensed Muslims worldwide and drove the Khilafat agitation into its mass non-cooperation phase.

qe: The Royal Commission on Decentralization (1908) made a critical recommendation regarding the financial and administrative responsibilities of urban municipalities. What role did it suggest they should play in primary education?
qh: रॉयल कमीशन ऑन विकेंद्रीकरण (1908) ने शहरी नगर पालिकाओं की वित्तीय और प्रशासनिक जिम्मेदारियों के संबंध में एक महत्वपूर्ण सिफारिश की थी। इसने प्राथमिक शिक्षा में उनकी क्या भूमिका सुझाया था?
o: The municipalities might explicitly undertake the responsibility for primary education and, if willing, for middle vernacular schools
They should be completely barred from funding or managing any primary-level educational facilities locally
They were legally forced to route 100% of their primary school tax revenues directly to the Dayal Singh Trust in Lahore
The Commission suggested that municipalities should manage only high-cost advanced technical engineering universities
e: Detailed Explanation: To optimize local governance, the 1908 Decentralization Commission recommended that urban municipalities should explicitly take over the responsibility for funding and administering primary education and, if willing, middle vernacular schools, while being relieved of secondary education burdens.

qe: What retrogressive evaluation did the Simon Commission outline in its May 1930 report regarding the efficiency and financial management of local self-governing bodies since 1919?
qh: साइमन कमीशन ने मई 1930 की अपनी रिपोर्ट में 1919 के बाद से स्थानीय स्वशासी निकायों के कुशल और वित्तीय प्रबंधन के संबंध में कौन सा प्रतिगामी (retrogressive) मूल्यांकन प्रस्तुत किया था?
o: It claimed that the management of finances had deteriorated, and suggested the retrograde step of increasing provincial bureaucratic control over local bodies
It celebrated the village panchayats for successfully achieving absolute financial independence across all provinces
It demanded that 100% of local tax revenues must be channeled directly to support the All India Kisan Sabha
The Commission recommended the complete permanent legal abolition of the office of the district magistrate
e: Detailed Explanation: The Simon Commission (May 1930) noted that the financial management of local bodies had deteriorated since the introduction of the 1919 reforms, pointing out a lack of progress in village panchayats. Instead of expanding democracy, it recommended a retrograde step: increasing tight provincial bureaucratic control over these local bodies in the name of efficiency.

qe: What macro-level transformation occurred to India's dynamic share of global manufacturing exports across the centuries of British colonial rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के सदियों के दौरान वैश्विक विनिर्माण निर्यात (world manufacturing exports) में भारत की गतिशील हिस्सेदारी में बड़े पैमाने पर क्या परिवर्तन आया?
o: It dramatically fell from 27 per cent down to a mere 2 per cent
It increased steadily from 2 per cent up to an optimized 27 per cent
It remained perfectly constant at a balanced 10 per cent layout
It dropped to zero instantly within the first decade of the Charter Act of 1813
e: Detailed Explanation: As highlighted by modern economic historians, the systemic deindustrialization and forced commercialization under British rule caused India's share of world manufacturing exports to crash from a dominant 27 per cent down to a mere 2 per cent by the end of the colonial era.

qe: A logistics routing path maps an exact right-angled triangular course from depot O. A vehicle moves 40 km North, and then shifts orientation to move 9 km East to reach target point B. Find the straight-line distance from O to B.
qh: एक कार डिपो O से 40 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 9 किमी जाकर गंतव्य B पर पहुँचती है। O से B की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 41 km
49 km
43 km
45 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial movement tracks a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs measuring 40 km and 9 km. The straight-line distance represents the hypotenuse.
By applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{40^2 + 9^2} = \sqrt{1600 + 81} = \sqrt{1681} = \mathbf{41\text{ km}}$.
